governanceRules: Use the Gazette as primary fee authority where it provides an applicable CAC fee.
Use the April 2026 SLA for service scope, requirements, procedure, channel and turnaround time.
Do not treat stamp duty as a CAC service fee; preserve it as a separate statutory/external charge.
Do not treat penalties as ordinary service fees; store/display them separately.
If SLA and Gazette conflict on a CAC fee, preserve the conflict until formally reconciled; do not silently choose an amount.
Do not publish a verified state merely because an internal catalogue field says verified; require the existing authorised human-review event.
